title: Make runtime SDI header generation atomic and independent of the working directory
body: VIXEN generates SDI headers at runtime into ./generated/sdi (ShaderBundleBuilder generateSdi_ default true; SpirvInterfaceGenerator.h:17, SdiRegistryManager.h:70, BuildInstancingDemoGraph.cpp:210) with plain std::ofstream. Concurrent processes from one directory rewrite the same files non-atomically and SDI_Registry.g.h is not content-keyed. Use AtomicWriteText into a per-user/per-process dir or skip in non-development runs. Tier reason: several files, moderate investigation of who consumes the headers.

title: Native Windows VIXEN build on the authoring-convergence base fails in codegen: pin b1576418 allowlist rejected, c28f5ee45 override fails recipe_simd_check
body: Native build of lane-vixenmultiproc (base 96196995) with the undertow main-wave worktree: with the tracked pin b1576418 the CodegenTool build stops on YK_KF_4039 'EntityIdUsage.allowlist.tsv malformed manifest row 3'; with VIXEN_YEROKET_KERNEL_SHA_OVERRIDE=c28f5ee45 the recipe_simd_check stamp fails (usage error from --recipe-simd-cpp), so VIXEN.exe is not linked. Also UNDERTOW_ROOT forwarded through vixen-native.sh arrives with backslashes (\\wsl.localhost\\Ubuntu...) and breaks codegen VerifyGlobs.cmake ('Invalid character escape \\U'); YEROKET_ROOT through the ~/Github symlink is rejected as not a directory. Needs: pin/catalogue pairing documented for lanes, to_cmake_path on UNDERTOW_ROOT in codegen/CMakeLists.txt, and vixen-native.sh forwarding forward-slash UNC paths. Tier reason: unclear pairing, needs measurement.
